description: Reentrancy in StakingPool_1005.pullFunds() (AuditTarget.sol#36-42): 	External calls: 	- (ok,None) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}() (AuditTarget.sol#39) 	State variables written after the call(s): 	- shares[msg.sender] = 0 (AuditTarget.sol#41) 	StakingPool_1005.shares (AuditTarget.sol#12) can be used in cross function reentrancies: 	- StakingPool_1005.pullFunds() (AuditTarget.sol#36-42) 	- StakingPool_1005.save() (AuditTarget.sol#26-29) 	- StakingPool_1005.shares (AuditTarget.sol#12)
StakingPool_1005.shutdown() (AuditTarget.sol#53-55) allows anyone to destruct the contract
StakingPool_1005.isEmpty() (AuditTarget.sol#49-51) uses a dangerous strict equality: 	- address(this).balance == 0 (AuditTarget.sol#50)
StakingPool_1005.updateOwner(address) (AuditTarget.sol#57-61) uses tx.origin for authorization: require(bool,string)(tx.origin == owner,not owner) (AuditTarget.sol#58)
StakingPool_1005.flush(address) (AuditTarget.sol#44-47) ignores return value by to.call{value: address(this).balance}() (AuditTarget.sol#46)
